_source: Devin CLI 3000.12.57. Hook stdin fields (hook_event_name, session_id, tool_name, tool_input) and the block output {decision, reason} from docs.devin.ai/cli/extensibility/hooks/lifecycle-hooks.md and .../hooks/overview.md (read 2026-11-21). The ask_user_question argument names (questions[], header, options[{label, description}], multi_select) are from the tool schema text embedded in the installed devin binary; the question text's own key is not legible there and is taken to be `question`.
